description: Vergunde voertuigen Individueel bezoldigd personenvervoer is a dataset listed in transportdata.be, a national access point for transport data, published or maintained by Departement Mobiliteit en Openbare Werken. The dataset includes all licensed vehicles in the context of the Individual Paid Passenger Transportation as stated in the decreet van 29 maart 2019 betreffende het individueel bezoldigd personenvervoer. Coverage: Belgium (see the dataset page for the exact area). The portal lists 1 resource in CSV. The data standards named are other. The national access point types are MMTIS. The portal shows 2025-07-01 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support mobility and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-transportdata-be-national-access-point.
